verdict.rationale: Insomnia's docs describe collections as the container for HTTP, gRPC, GraphQL and WebSocket requests, created from a collection's left panel. A Collection Runner sends multiple requests in a specified order, and pricing advertises unlimited collection runs. Folders are implied by folder-level environments, and a community user values recalling saved requests without re-entering data. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of creating and nesting folders to organize requests, and stronger independent hands-on corroboration of the organize-and-rerun workflow.
